planItem: 77.44.7.A/C — tablet Flex/Grid Inspector contexts for every shared layout type
finding: Desktop/mobile Flex/Grid context coverage existed for all 18 shared layout types, and representative/tablet property matrices existed, but the combined tablet context lifecycle across all 18 types was unverified.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-layout-tablet-context-lifecycle.test.js. It creates every shared layout type with alternating desktop Flex/Grid styles, selects the opposite mode at tablet width and exercises all relevant container and child fields through the real Inspector.
coverage: All 18 shared layout container types; tablet responsive.set command/key contract; Canvas and public computed CSS; tablet draft Save and Editor reload; Save does not publish; tablet Publish; mobile inherits tablet when it has no override; desktop remains unchanged; tablet container/item inheritance resets; Undo/Redo; reset Save leaves tablet publication unchanged; separate reset Publish restores desktop layout and removes the tablet fallback on mobile.
harnessNotes: A first assertion expected mobile to skip the tablet value; the existing responsive cascade and prior breakpoint test show mobile inherits tablet unless it has a mobile override. The assertion now verifies that cascade, then verifies mobile returns to desktop inheritance after tablet reset Publish.
Grid fr pixel widths are viewport-dependent; parity compares resolved track count while the exact template is asserted in the saved Page Model.
The parent display override resets after its mode-specific child fields, since changing the mode changes which child controls are visible.

reuseReview.solution: Extended the project's existing Playwright/Chromium Inspector fixture and reused the shared layout type registry, responsive Inspector controls, command engine, CSS projection and Save/Publish server fixture.
